title: 第19章 对云珏好点第20章 让你们掀车没让你们砸车
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田

“她说，若我非要和离，就滚去封地。”
沈青鱼的神色自然，“我觉得滚去封地也挺好的，反正离上京挺近的，没事我还能回来打……哦，回来找皇伯父您唠嗑。”
宣和帝：别以为我没听出来‘打秋风’三个字。
“莫要犯傻，青城早被妖魔占据，那些猪妖力量太过强大，且十分狡猾，连镇妖司也奈何不了它们。”宣和帝叹气。
否则皇朝又怎会舍得放弃那块肥地，从前那可是大渊粮仓。如今的大渊表面看着似乎还行，实则百姓食不果腹，内忧外患。
“皇伯父不如跟我讲讲青城？”沈青鱼把杯子推了过去。
宣和帝一边斟茶一边说道：“青城紧挨着大青山，那些个妖魔不见得十分强大，却狡猾得很，一旦有镇魔军前去围剿，它们就会跑进大青山去。大青山地形复杂，山峦极多，镇魔军尝试进入几次，都损失惨重，是以不得不放弃青城。”
本意是想让沈青鱼放弃，怎料抬眼时却发现她两眼放光。
他心头一突，手跟着抖了下。
是他太久没回上京，还是这丫头本就这个性子，要和离了才暴露出来？
他打量了下，蹙眉沉思。
还是入门武道了，觉得自己浑身有劲了，就想要嘚瑟。
其实沈青鱼在想，青城妖魔多点也挺好的，那样她和小梨就不必费劲去寻找妖魔，等着它们送上门来。
修炼了吞天诀，没有什么比妖魔更适合她们吞噬修炼的了。
“皇伯父，这青城我肯定要去的。”沈青鱼一脸认真地说道。
“就为了和离？”宣和帝皱眉，这事他确实不好掺和，可让他就这么眼睁睁看着宝贝侄女去送死，他觉得掺和一下也不是不可以。
“是，也不全是。主要是我看那块地挺肥的，想要试一下。”
有关于吞天诀的事情，沈青鱼觉得还是先不说了，等她武道修为上去了再说也不迟。
现在说了，皇伯父不仅不会同意她去青城，还会消耗人力物力替她狩猎妖魔。

沈青鱼又道：“我有十六暗卫，三百府兵，若真遇到什么危险，我还能把云珏这个大冰棍丢出去。”
宣和帝嘴角抽搐，一脸无语地看着她。
“你对云珏好点。”
“我对他挺好的啊，吃的住的穿的，哪样都顶好的。为了给他疗伤，我上次从皇伯父您这里得到的宝药都用光了。”
“……”
宣和帝眼皮子一跳，生出不妙感，下意识挥手赶人。
“你母亲不是给你三天时间考虑吗，朕也觉得你需要冷静考虑一下，赶紧回去吧。”
沈青鱼厚着脸皮没走，眨巴着眼睛看他。
宣和帝头皮发麻，这丫头瞧着单纯又无辜的眼神底下似乎藏诈。
“皇伯父，上次我从内库拿走了一个黑玉盒子的事情你是知道的吧？”
“不是盒子碎了，里面的东西也碎了吗？”
“皇伯父果然心疼侄女，连这件事都知道。不过皇伯父您还不知道吧，那东西没碎，只是裂了。更重要的是，它吸收了我的真气后发芽了。”
“发芽就发芽了呗，又不是什么新鲜事。”

"She said that if I insist on making peace, I will go to the fiefdom."
Shen Qingyu's expression was natural, "I think it's good to go to the fiefdom. Anyway, it's quite close to Shangjing. If nothing happens, I can come back to fight... Oh, I'll chat with you when I come back, Uncle Huang."
Emperor Xuanhe: Don’t think I didn’t hear the word ‘beating the autumn wind’.
"Don't be stupid. Qingcheng has long been occupied by demons. Those pig demons are so powerful and cunning that even the Demon Suppression Department can't do anything to them." Emperor Xuanhe sighed.
Otherwise, how could the dynasty be willing to give up that fertile land, which used to be the granary of Dayuan. Today's Dayuan seems to be doing well on the surface, but in fact the people are starved of food and suffer from internal and external troubles.
"Uncle Huang, why don't you tell me about Qingcheng?" Shen Qingyu pushed the cup over.
Emperor Xuanhe poured tea and said, "Qingcheng is close to Daqingshan. Those demons are not necessarily very powerful, but they are very cunning. Once the demon-suppressing army comes to encircle and suppress them, they will run into Daqingshan. The terrain of Daqingshan is complex and there are many mountains. The demon-suppressing army tried to enter several times, but suffered heavy losses, so they had to abandon Qingcheng."
The original intention was to make Shen Qingyu give up, but when he raised his eyes, he found her eyes shining.
His heart suddenly trembled, and his hands trembled.
Is it because he hasn't been back to Beijing for a long time, or is this girl's temperament already exposed, and she wants to get divorced?
He looked at it, frowning in thought.
I was just getting started in martial arts. I felt that I was full of energy and wanted to play the lute.
In fact, Shen Qingyu was thinking that it would be good to have more demons in Qingcheng, so that she and Xiaoli would not have to go out to find the demons and wait for them to come to their door.
After practicing the Heaven Swallowing Technique, there is nothing more suitable for them to swallow and practice than demons.
"Uncle Huang, I will definitely go to Qingcheng." Shen Qingyu said seriously.
"Just for peace and separation?" Emperor Xuanhe frowned. It was really hard for him to get involved in this matter, but if he just watched his precious niece die, he felt that it was not impossible to get involved.
"Yes, not entirely. Mainly because I think the land is quite fat and I want to give it a try."
Shen Qingyu thought it would be better not to talk about the Heaven-Swallowing Jue until her martial arts skills improved.
Now that I have said it, not only will Uncle Huang not agree to her going to Qingcheng, but he will also waste manpower and material resources hunting monsters for her.
Shen Qingyu added: "I have sixteen secret guards and three hundred soldiers. If we encounter any danger, I can still throw this big popsicle like Yun Jue out."
Emperor Xuanhe's mouth twitched and he looked at her speechlessly.
"Be nice to Yun Jue."
"I am very good to him. Food, housing and clothing are all the best. In order to heal him, I have used up all the precious medicine I got from you, Uncle Emperor."
"..."
Emperor Xuanhe's eyelids twitched, he had a bad feeling, and subconsciously waved his hand to drive people away.
"Didn't your mother give you three days to think about it? I also think you need to calm down and think about it. Go back quickly."
Shen Qingyu shamelessly didn't leave, blinking at him.
Emperor Xuanhe's scalp was numb. This girl seemed to be hiding deceit under her innocent and innocent eyes.
"Uncle Huang, you know that I took a black jade box from the inner treasury last time, right?"
"Isn't it true that the box is broken and the contents inside are also broken?"
"Uncle Huang really cares about his niece, and he even knows about it. But don't you know, Uncle Huang, that thing is not broken, just cracked. More importantly, it sprouted after absorbing my energy."
"It just sprouted. It's nothing new."
